title: Drop unused includes in torch/csrc and caffe2/serialize
body:
## Summary

Split out of #194958. Removes unused `#include`s in torch/csrc and
caffe2/serialize, flagged by clang-tidy's misc-include-cleaner (not
enabled by this repo's `.clang-tidy`/lintrunner config).
